Queue

The queued-actions list: a collapsible section with the count on the trigger and a remove action per row. The component NEVER owns the queue — caller state, onRemove callback, and the pure remove/enqueue/count helpers in queue.logic. Rows compose the item primitive; actions are always visible (the web's hover-reveal is dead on touch) and the list scrolls under a max-h cap.

  • v0.2.1
  • component
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/queue.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/queue.json

Theming

Themed via border-border, bg-muted, bg-accent, text-muted-foreground, text-foreground, bg-background.

Usage

() => ( <Queue onRemove={() => {}}> <QueueSection defaultOpen> <QueueSectionTrigger label="Queued installs" count={2} /> <QueueList> <QueueItem id="q-1"> <QueueItemContent> <Text className="text-sm text-foreground">terminal.json</Text> <QueueItemDescription>ANSI surface · runs after the current install</QueueItemDescription> </QueueItemContent> <QueueItemRemove label="Remove terminal.json from the queue" /> </QueueItem> <QueueItem id="q-2" completed> <QueueItemContent> <Text className="text-sm text-foreground">conversation.json</Text> <QueueItemDescription>installed from v0.2.0</QueueItemDescription> </QueueItemContent> </QueueItem> </QueueList> </QueueSection> </Queue> )

The TextClassContext seam

This component publishes its class strings through the TextClassContext provider, so a parent view can restyle its nested text.
